headlines.title: 英国经济创两年半最快增速 AI支出提供助力
headlines.summary: 英国经济创两年半最快增速，人工智能的推广带动企业支出，消费者支出也顶住了伊朗冲突引发的能源冲击。英国国家统计局周四公布，第三季度国内生产总值(GDP)环比增长0.7%，较第二季度的0.5%加快，符合预期。仅9月份GDP就增长0.2%，好于此前预期的零增长。自伊朗冲突爆发以来，英国经济表现强于此前有关经济放缓的预期，其中与采用人工智能相关的支出提供了支撑。经济学家已被迫上调今年的经济增长预测。英国财政大臣约翰·希利周三表示，他的目标是让2027年经济表现再次超过预期。按人均计算，第三季度产出增长0.7%，为2021年底以来最大增幅，当时英国经济正从新冠疫情

headlines.title_en: UK economy posts fastest growth in two and a half years, aided by AI spending
headlines.summary_en: UK economy grows at fastest pace in two and a half years, with AI adoption driving business spending and consumer spending withstanding the energy shock caused by the Iran conflict. The Office for National Statistics said Thursday that GDP grew 0.7% quarter-on-quarter in Q3, accelerating from 0.5% in Q2 and in line with expectations. GDP alone rose 0.2% in September, better than the previous expectation of zero growth. Since the Iran conflict broke out, the UK economy has outperformed earlier expectations of a slowdown, supported by spending related to AI adoption. Economists have been forced to raise their growth forecasts for this year. UK Chancellor John Healey said Wednesday that his goal is for the economy to beat expectations again in 2027. On a per capita basis, output rose 0.7% in Q3, the largest increase since late 2021, when the UK economy was recovering from the COVID-19 pandemic

headlines.title: 外媒称西北工业大学购买英伟达H200芯片，不符合美对华出口限制，外交部回应
headlines.summary: 11月12日，外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。法新社记者提问，据报道，中国的西北工业大学购买了英伟达H200芯片，而这不符合美国对华的出口限制。请问外交部对此有何评论？毛宁表示，你提到的具体情况，我不了解。中方在美国输华芯片问题上的立场是一贯的。同时，我们坚决反对美方泛化国家安全概念、划设各种名目的歧视性清单无理打压中国机构。（上观新闻）

headlines.title_en: Foreign media reports Northwestern Polytechnical University purchased Nvidia H200 chips, not in violation of US export restrictions to China; Foreign Ministry responds
headlines.summary_en: On November 12, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning hosted a regular press conference. An AFP reporter asked: according to reports, China's Northwestern Polytechnical University purchased Nvidia H200 chips, which does not comply with US export restrictions on China. What is the Foreign Ministry's comment? Mao Ning said: I am not aware of the specific situation you mentioned. China's position on the issue of US chip exports to China is consistent. At the same time, we firmly oppose the US side's generalization of the national security concept, drawing up various discriminatory lists under various pretexts, and unreasonably suppressing Chinese institutions. (Shangguan News)

headlines.title: 工信部：国家产融合作平台助企融资超1.8万亿元
headlines.summary: 据工业和信息化部消息，<u>目前国家产融合作平台助企融资规模已突破1.8万亿元</u>，平台入驻企业超过40万家。国家产融合作平台是依托工业和信息化部及相关金融机构数据资源建立的非营利性公共服务平台，可以为企业提供定制化、智能化的金融服务。为了推动企业融资需求和金融产品的精准匹配，平台建立数据对接共享机制，共享多个部门和机构数据，并通过整合重点企业标签，挖掘数据模型算法价值。<u>截至2026年10月，平台入驻企业46万家，其中制造业企业占比60%</u>。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: National industry-finance cooperation platform helps enterprises raise over RMB 1.8 trillion
headlines.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the national industry-finance cooperation platform has now facilitated more than 1.8 trillion yuan in financing for enterprises, with more than 400,000 enterprises registered on the platform. The national industry-finance cooperation platform is a non-profit public service platform built on data resources from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and relevant financial institutions, providing enterprises with customized and intelligent financial services. To promote precise matching of enterprise financing needs and financial products, the platform has established a data docking and sharing mechanism, sharing data from multiple departments and institutions, and tapping the value of data model algorithms by integrating key enterprise tags. As of October 2026, 460,000 enterprises were registered on the platform, of which manufacturing enterprises accounted for 60%.

headlines.title: 香港金管局与香港证监会合办研讨会，推动香港代币化发展并推广Ensemble项目合作机遇
headlines.summary: 香港金管局与证监会11月11日合办研讨会，聚焦Ensemble项目及代币化证监会认可投资产品，约200名业界人士出席。紧接金管局在2026香港金融科技周宣布EnsembleTX迈进新阶段，实现银行间代币化存款24/7全天候结算；证监会批准代币化货币市场基金进行24/7全天候二级市场交易。展望未来，Ensemble将引入更多具影响力的代币化用例、扩大交易规模，金管局将继续与证监会及业界合作，拓展代币化存款商业应用。（界面新闻）

headlines.title_en: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar to promote tokenization development in Hong Kong and Ensemble project cooperation opportunities
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and the Securities and Futures Commission co-hosted a seminar on November 11 focusing on the Ensemble project and tokenized SFC-authorized investment products, with about 200 industry participants attending. This followed the HKMA's announcement at Hong Kong FinTech Week 2026 that EnsembleTX has entered a new phase, enabling 24/7 round-the-clock settlement of interbank tokenized deposits; the SFC has approved tokenized money market funds for 24/7 round-the-clock secondary market trading. Looking ahead, Ensemble will introduce more impactful tokenization use cases and expand transaction scale, and the HKMA will continue to work with the SFC and the industry to expand commercial applications of tokenized deposits. (Jiemian News)

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: China-EU medical devices matchmaking event reaches over 100 cooperation intentions
headlines.summary_en: On November 12, Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong said at a regular press conference that the recently held China-EU medical devices trade matchmaking meeting was an important outcome and consensus of the second regular meeting of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism. The Ministry of Commerce, together with the Ministry of Finance, the National Health Commission and other departments, organized more than 160 domestic medical institutions and enterprises to participate in market-based procurement, while the EU side organized more than 40 medical device enterprises to attend, and the two sides reached more than 100 cooperation intentions. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 中信银行：2026年半年度派发A股现金红利82.75亿元 股权登记日为11月19日
headlines.summary: 中信银行公告，2026年半年度分红派息方案为每股派发现金红利0.203元(含税)，共计派发现金红利约112.96亿元，其中，派发A股现金红利人民币82.75亿元(含税)。A股股权登记日为2026年11月19日，除权除息日及现金红利发放日为2026年11月20日。

headlines.title_en: China CITIC Bank: to pay RMB 8.275 billion in A-share cash dividends for H1 2026; record date November 19
headlines.summary_en: China CITIC Bank announced that its 2026 interim dividend plan is a cash dividend of RMB 0.203 per share (tax included), totaling approximately RMB 11.296 billion in cash dividends, of which A-share cash dividends will be RMB 8.275 billion (tax included). The A-share record date is November 19, 2026, and the ex-rights/ex-dividend date and cash dividend payment date is November 20, 2026.

headlines.title: *ST卓然：公司及全资子公司被诉，涉供应链保理融资本金8011.79万元
headlines.summary: 金十数据11月12日讯，*ST卓然公告，公司近日收到上海市黄浦区人民法院送达的传票、《民事起诉状》及相关材料，上海农村商业银行股份有限公司黄浦支行就供应链保理合同纠纷，将公司及两家全资子公司卓然(靖江)设备制造有限公司、上海卓然数智能源有限公司列为共同被告提起民事诉讼，法院已立案受理，尚未开庭审理。原告诉请判令公司支付供应链保理融资本金合计人民币8011.79万元，并以该本金为基数按约定融资利率上浮50%计算逾期利息至实际清偿之日止。原告称2025年6-12月以无追索权保理方式受让部分供应商对三被告的应收账款，涉及本金合计8011.79万元，后部分保理业

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 12: *ST Zhuoran announced that the company recently received a summons, a Civil Complaint and related materials served by the Huangpu District People's Court of Shanghai. headlines.title: 当虹科技：收到5亿元科技创新债券接受注册通知书
headlines.summary: 金十数据11月12日讯，当虹科技公告，公司此前审议通过拟申请注册发行最高不超过5亿元科技创新债券的议案，近日收到中国银行间市场交易商协会出具的《接受注册通知书》，交易商协会决定接受公司科技创新债券注册。本次注册基础品种为定向债务融资工具，注册金额5亿元，注册额度自通知书落款之日起2年内有效，由国信证券股份有限公司主承销，公司可在注册有效期内分期定向发行，将结合资金需求及市场情况择机实施发行事宜。

headlines.title_en: Arcvideo Technology: Receives RMB 500 million sci-tech innovation bond registration acceptance notice
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 12: Arcvideo Technology announced that the company had previously reviewed and approved a proposal to apply for registration and issuance of no more than 500 million yuan of sci-tech innovation bonds, and recently received the Notice of Acceptance of Registration issued by the National Association of Financial Market Institutional Investors, which decided to accept the registration of the company's sci-tech innovation bonds. The underlying variety for this registration is a targeted debt financing instrument, with a registered amount of 500 million yuan. The registration quota is valid for two years from the date of the notice, with Guosen Securities Co., Ltd. as lead underwriter. The company may issue in tranches on a targeted basis during the registration validity period, and will implement the issuance at an appropriate time in light of funding needs and market conditions.

headlines.title_en: Southbound funds post large net buying of RMB 5.846 billion today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound funds recorded a large net purchase of 5.846 billion yuan today. On the Stock Connect (Shanghai) side, Alibaba-W and Zhipu received net purchases of HK$2.121 billion and HK$516 million respectively; Hua Hong Semiconductor saw the largest net sale, at HK$10 million; on the Stock Connect (Shenzhen) side, Zhipu and Kingboard Laminates received net purchases of HK$327 million and HK$111 million respectively; Alibaba-W saw the largest net sale, at HK$997 million.

headlines.summary_en: On November 12, the Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A media reporter asked on site: Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer on November 6. As the APEC Shenzhen summit is about to be held next week, how does the Ministry of Commerce assess the current differences and cooperation progress in China-US economic and trade relations?

headlines.title: 金房能源：控股股东杨建勋等终止协议转让10.46%股份
headlines.summary: 金房能源公告，公司控股股东、实际控制人杨建勋及其一致行动人魏澄、付英、丁琦此前于2026年1月4日分别与富强资产、能敬资本签署《股份转让协议》，杨建勋拟向富强资产转让825.7万股（占公司总股本的5.27%），魏澄、付英、丁琦拟向能敬资本转让合计814.57万股（占公司总股本的5.19%）。截至公告披露日，上述拟协议转让的股份尚未办理过户登记手续，且深圳证券交易所出具的《上市公司股份协议转让确认书》已过有效期，故终止本次协议转让事项。

headlines.title_en: Jinfang Energy: controlling shareholder Yang Jianxun and others terminate agreement to transfer 10.46% of shares
headlines.summary_en: Jinfang Energy announced that the company's controlling shareholder and actual controller Yang Jianxun and his concert parties Wei Cheng, Fu Ying and Ding Qi previously signed Share Transfer Agreements on January 4, 2026 with Fuqiang Assets and Nengjing Capital respectively. Yang Jianxun planned to transfer 8,257,000 shares (5.27% of the company's total share capital) to Fuqiang Assets, and Wei Cheng, Fu Ying and Ding Qi planned to transfer a total of 8,145,700 shares (5.19% of the company's total share capital) to Nengjing Capital. As of the announcement date, the above shares proposed for agreement transfer have not yet completed transfer registration procedures, and the Confirmation Letter for Agreement Transfer of Shares of Listed Companies issued by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has expired, so this agreement transfer is terminated.

headlines.title: 香港交易所：以人民币计价、挂钩人民币货币基金的衍生权证今日上市
headlines.summary: 香港交易所发文称，一只以以人民币计价、挂钩人民币货币基金(82800.HK)的衍生权证今日上市。这是时隔约十年，人民币衍生权证再度亮相香港市场，为投资者带来更多人民币产品选择。该权证目前是香港市场上唯一一只以人民币计价的衍生权证。

headlines.title_en: HKEX: RMB-denominated derivative warrants linked to RMB money market funds listed today
headlines.summary_en: HKEX said in a statement that a derivative warrant denominated in RMB and linked to an RMB money market fund (82800.HK) listed today. This marks the return of RMB derivative warrants to the Hong Kong market after about a decade, giving investors more RMB product choices. The warrant is currently the only RMB-denominated derivative warrant in the Hong Kong market.

headlines.title: “对敲”白银期权，私募基金天算量化员工被罚
headlines.summary: 知名量化私募天算量化（北京）资本管理有限公司被上海期货交易所处罚。近日，上海期货交易所披露的一则违规处理决定公告显示，今年2月12日，都健使用本人账户、天算指增保护专享2号私募证券投资基金账户，在白银期权合约上相互交易，扰乱市场秩序。

headlines.title_en: 'Wash trading' silver options, Tiansuan Quant private fund employee penalized
headlines.summary_en: Well-known quantitative private fund manager Tiansuan Quantitative (Beijing) Capital Management Co., Ltd. was penalized by the Shanghai Futures Exchange. A recent disciplinary decision disclosed by the SHFE shows that on February 12 this year, Du Jian used his personal account and the Tiansuan Index Enhancement Protection Exclusive No. 2 private securities investment fund account to trade with each other in silver options contracts, disrupting market order.

headlines.title: 安联投资William Russell：中国资产在全球资产配置中扮演更加战略性角色
headlines.summary: 在上交所国际投资者大会上，安联投资亚太区股票产品专家主管William Russell表示，从全球投资者角度来看，中国资产在全球资产配置中已扮演更加战略性角色，目前已不是何时配置的问题，而是如何战略性配置。“在过去几周的波动中，国际投资者越来越考虑在中国进行投资，来互补或分散现有的投资组合。”他说。 (证券时报)

headlines.title_en: Allianz Global Investors' William Russell: Chinese assets play a more strategic role in global asset allocation
headlines.summary_en: At the SSE Global Investor Conference, William Russell, Head of Asia-Pacific Equity Product Specialists at Allianz Global Investors, said that from a global investor's perspective, Chinese assets have come to play a more strategic role in global asset allocation, and the question is no longer when to allocate but how to allocate strategically. "Amid the volatility of recent weeks, international investors are increasingly considering investing in China to complement or diversify their existing portfolios," he said. (Securities Times)
